run_PromptDiffusionPipeline: run the PromptDiffusionPipeline to generate images from a text prompt with ControlNet guidance and image pair conditioning
create_PromptDiffusionPipeline: create a PromptDiffusionPipeline instance with VAE, text encoder, tokenizer, UNet, ControlNet, scheduler, and safety checker components
encode_prompt: encode text prompts into CLIP hidden state embeddings with optional negative prompts, LoRA scaling, and clip skip support
encode_image: encode input images into CLIP vision embeddings for use as conditioning in the prompt diffusion pipeline
test_retrieve_timesteps: test the retrieve_timesteps helper function that configures a scheduler and returns its timestep schedule
